correctness.rationale: Exactly n distinct formal letters and every permitted factor length. The alternating projection onto Z_(n−1) induces bijections of Parikh classes for even and each of the two disjoint odd cases. Boundary values 0 and out-of-range are handled. Induction identifies reversed Stern values; row-sum recursion proves (3^n−1)/2, adjacent-pair induction proves maximal F_(n+1), Jacobsthal Stern recurrence proves attainment. Standalone full enumerator replayed ranks 1–9; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact natural length-by-length Abelian factor complexity for a classical family and all ranks; not a renaming of numeric sequence because a new structural projection establishes the word-language correspondence. Exact (3^n−1)/2 global Parikh spectrum and sharp Fibonacci extremality at Jacobsthal lengths are structurally explanatory and allow logarithmic-time direct evaluations of individual length counts. General inverse-image/anagram factor questions motivate this exact invariant.
